source.method: High-strictness Stage 0 screen using the hiring-plan metrics and resume text evidence only. Strict advance threshold is 17/20; the original hiring-plan pass bar is 14/20 and is treated as manual-hold territory here. This is decision support, not an automated hiring decision.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Full-stack production experience
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Has shipped production browser-based applications and backend services/APIs.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Backend/API/database depth
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Can show API, data modeling, migration, async workflow, integration, or distributed-system ownership.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Testing/debugging/production support
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Has meaningful automated testing, debugging, CI/CD, observability, or production support experience.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Security/reliability awareness
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Mentions auth, validation, secrets, data protection, reliability, monitoring, or regulated workflows.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Ownership/mentoring/communication
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Has owned outcomes, reviewed code, mentored juniors, or led technical discussions.

resume_screen_rubric.label: Agentic tool usage or interest
resume_screen_rubric.strong_evidence: Has used or is clearly interested in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar tools with judgment.

round1.name: Round 1 HR phone screen
round1.hard_rule: HR must confirm role fit, company fit, communication, availability, compensation range, and under-7-years experience before moving to a video call.
questions: Why are you interested in this role and Complyance?
Which parts of your recent work best match this senior developer role?
Confirm your total hands-on software engineering experience and current notice period.
What salary range and work arrangement are you expecting?
Are there any role, location, timing, or availability constraints we should know before scheduling the next round?
What kind of company environment helps you do your best work?

round2.name: Round 2 technical and decision call
round2.hard_rule: This HR + Sanjay video call carries the main technical decision. Do not hire if practical technical judgment, ownership, testing, security, or working-code evidence is weak.
questions: Walk through a production feature you owned end to end, including the tradeoffs you made.
Given an ambiguous compliance workflow requirement, what questions would you ask before implementation?
Design the API, database model, and permissions for a multi-user hiring workflow with audit history.
How would you test the critical paths and debug a production issue after release?
Show or describe a recent code change where you improved correctness, security, or maintainability.
How do you use AI coding tools without losing accountability for correctness and privacy?
What decision would make you stop a release even if the feature looks complete?

round3.name: Round 3 final panel
round3.hard_rule: Final Meiyappan + Sanjay + HR video call must validate product judgment, team fit, ownership maturity, and final mutual alignment.
questions: What type of technical ownership do you want in your next role?
How would you handle a disagreement with founders about product priority or technical risk?
Tell us about a time you had to make progress with incomplete requirements.
How do you balance speed, reliability, and customer trust in a small team?
What would you need from us to be successful in the first 90 days?
Do compensation, joining date, work mode, and role expectations still align?
